newsitem.title: USA: US aluminum industry shipments dip 1.2 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: US aluminum industry shipments dip 1.2 pct in 1996.

text.p: U.S. aluminum industry shipments, including exports, totaled 20.825 billion pounds or 9,017,858 tonnes in 1996, down 1.2 percent from 1995, according to preliminary Aluminum Association figures.
U.S. exports of aluminum ingot and mill products rose less than one percent to 2.889 billion pounds last year, while imports fell 4.8 percent to 5.671 billion pounds.
Domestic shipments in December totaled 1.442 billion pounds, up from 1.289 billion pounds in the previous December.
But domestic shipments for 1996 overall fell to 17.936 billion pounds from 18.189 billion pounds in 1995.
The Aluminum Association has introduced a new index to indicate order levels, replacing an estimate of volume.
Using 1994 as the base year of 100 points, orders in January rose to 105.84 points compared with December's 87.99 points. Orders in January 1996 were at 94.90 points.
Domestic canstock orders in January this year rose to 107.35 points, up from 87.91 points in December.
